# Weapon reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs from data/weapons/*.ron and data/rulesets/paint_the_void.ron. Do not edit by hand: change the
     data and run `node tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs` (CI fails while this file is stale). -->

Every weapon's numbers as this build's data files define them. What each weapon does, its
malus and its lasting effect are in the [player manual](../player-manual.md#weapons).

How to read the tables:

- **Damage** is per direct hit at level 1 before the ship's damage multiplier (Skitter
  0.85x, Tinker 1x, Hauler 1.2x, Tug 0.8x, see [ships](ships.md)). `×N` means N projectiles
  per shot. Friendly fire scales damage between teammates (50% by default).
- **Hits to kill** is the number of whole shots that destroy a full-hull Tinker (100 hull)
  with direct hits only (level 1, no charge, no splash).
- **Range** is speed times lifetime. Projectiles never inherit your ship's speed.
- **Splash** is the most area damage (at the centre, falling off to 0 at the radius).
- **Crater** sizes are diameters on ordinary rock. Weak rock (light, sandy) blasts 1.4x
  wider, hard rock (dark, glinting) 0.6x.
- **Shield** is how the weapon meets an enemy's active [Shield](gadgets.md#shield-and-weapons):
  blocked (the shield's energy pays, never the hull), wears it (energy pays, the hull takes
  what the energy cannot cover) or a share that passes through to the hull.
- **Default rules** is how Paint the Void (the built-in rule set) hands the weapon out.
  A server's rule set can change availability, pickups, ammo, damage and fire rate.

## Energy primaries

Powered by energy; bolts at about laser speed that a good pilot can dodge.

| Weapon | Slot | Damage | Hits to kill | Fire rate | Cost per shot | Speed (u/s) | Range (u) | Splash | Knockback (u/s) | Crater / paint | Shield | Default rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Scrap Laser** | primary | 6 (14 at level 6) | 17 | 4/s | 3 energy | 30 | 90 | – | 0.75 | – | wears it | start + pickup |
| **Scatter Laser** | primary | 3 ×3 | 12 | 3.3/s | 4.5 energy | 30 | 90 | – | 0.5 | – | wears it | pickup |
| **Plasma Repeater** | primary | 3 | 34 | 10/s | 3 energy | 33 | 49.5 | – | 0.5 | – | wears it | pickup |
| **Fusion Charger** | primary | 12 (48 charged) | 9 | 1/s | 12 energy | 30 | 90 | – | 3 | – | 50% passes through | pickup |
| **Corkscrew** | primary | 3 ×5 | 7 | 2/s | 6 energy | 30 | 60 | – | 0.3 | – | wears it | pickup |
| **Ricochet Arc** | primary | 6 | 17 | 3.3/s | 4 energy | 30 | 90 | – | 0.6 | – | wears it | pickup |
| **Leech Arc** | primary | 2 | 50 | 10/s | 0.5 energy | instant | 12 | – | 0.2 | – | 50% passes through | pickup |

- **Scrap Laser:** upgrades to level 6.
- **Scatter Laser:** damage falls to 40% towards the end of the bolt's life; 3 projectiles, 8° apart.
- **Fusion Charger:** holding past full charge burns 10 hull/s; hold to charge, full at 2 s.
- **Corkscrew:** 5 projectiles, 6° apart.
- **Ricochet Arc:** bounces off walls up to 3 times.
- **Leech Arc:** instant arc to a target within 12 u, drains 2 energy per arc.

## Kinetic primaries

Very fast rounds that fire your scrap, the same scrap that repairs your hull.

| Weapon | Slot | Damage | Hits to kill | Fire rate | Cost per shot | Speed (u/s) | Range (u) | Splash | Knockback (u/s) | Crater / paint | Shield | Default rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Rivet Gun** | primary | 3 | 34 | 10/s | 0.5 scrap | 180 | 180 | – | 0.3 | – | 50% passes through | pickup |
| **Railspike** | primary | 35 | 3 | 1 per 1.5 s | 4 scrap | 270 | 270 | – | 4 | crater Ø 0.6 u | 75% passes through | pickup |
| **Scrap Shotgun** | primary | 3 ×8 | 5 | 1.3/s | 4 scrap | 200 | 30 | – | 0.3 | – | 50% passes through | pickup |

- **Railspike:** pierces ships, debris and walls up to 2 u thick.
- **Scrap Shotgun:** damage falls to 30% by 24 u; 8 projectiles, 6° apart.

## Ordnance

Missiles and mines with a limited count, found as pickups.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Bolt Rocket** | secondary | 30 | 4 | 1.3/s | 1 (carry 10) | 40 | 160 | 20 within 2.5 u, hurts you | 8 | crater Ø 2 u | wears it | start + pickup, start with 3, 3 per pickup |
| **Seeker** | secondary | 30 | 4 | 1.3/s | 1 (carry 10) | 25 | 150 | 15 within 2.5 u, hurts you | 6 | crater Ø 2 u | wears it | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Quicksilver** | secondary | 25 | 4 | 1.7/s | 1 (carry 10) | 45 | 135 | 10 within 1.5 u, hurts you | 5 | crater Ø 2 u | wears it | pickup, 3 per pickup |
| **Eyeball** | secondary | 40 | 3 | 1/s | 1 (carry 3) | 25 | 200 | 25 within 3 u, hurts you | 8 | crater Ø 4 u | wears it | pickup, 1 per pickup |
| **Swarm Pod** | secondary | 15 | 7 | 1/s | 1 (carry 5) | 30 | 120 | 10 within 2 u, hurts you | 4 | crater Ø 1.5 u | wears it | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Heavy Rocket** | secondary | 70 | 2 | 1 per 1.5 s | 1 (carry 3) | 20 | 120 | 50 within 8 u, hurts you | 15 | crater Ø 6 u | wears it | pickup, 1 per pickup |
| **Flash Pod** | secondary | 0 | – | 1/s | 1 (carry 5) | 30 | 90 | – | 0 | – | blocked | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Prox Mine** | secondary | 40 | 3 | 2/s | 1 (carry 5) | 5 | mine, lasts 60 s | 50 within 5 u, hurts you | 8 | crater Ø 3 u | wears it | pickup, 3 per pickup |
| **Stalker Mine** | secondary | 35 | 3 | 1.3/s | 1 (carry 5) | 6 | mine, lasts 60 s | 45 within 4 u, hurts you | 7 | crater Ø 2 u | wears it | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Tectonic Charge** | secondary | 100 | 1 | 1 per 2 s | 1 (carry 1) | 15 | 150 | 110 within 25 u, hurts you | 20 | – | passes through | pickup, 1 per pickup |

- **Bolt Rocket:** gravity wells bend it.
- **Seeker:** homes on targets in a 30° cone within 60 u; gravity wells bend it.
- **Quicksilver:** gravity wells bend it.
- **Eyeball:** gravity wells bend it.
- **Swarm Pod:** releases 6 homing blobs of 6 damage on impact; gravity wells bend it.
- **Heavy Rocket:** gravity wells bend it.
- **Flash Pod:** blinds pilots within 15 u for 2 s; gravity wells bend it.
- **Prox Mine:** arms after 1 s, goes off within 2 u; gravity wells bend it.
- **Stalker Mine:** arms after 1 s, creeps at 4 u/s toward enemies within 10 u, goes off within 1.5 u; gravity wells bend it.
- **Tectonic Charge:** everything within 4 u dies; 6 sub-charges of 35 splash follow; gravity wells bend it.

## Specials

The comedy weapons: rarer pickups, each with its own trick.

| Weapon | Slot | Damage | Hits to kill | Fire rate | Cost per shot | Speed (u/s) | Range (u) | Splash | Knockback (u/s) | Crater / paint | Shield | Default rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Echo Cannon** | primary | 12 | 9 | 1.3/s | 8 energy | 30 | 135 | – | 1.5 | – | wears it | pickup |
| **Swap Harpoon** | secondary | 5 | 20 | 1 per 4 s | 1 (carry 5) | 60 | 90 | – | 0 | – | passes through | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Paint Thrower** | primary | 0 | – | 10/s | 1.5 energy | 20 | 30 | – | 0 | paint Ø 4 u | blocked | start only |
| **Borrowed Time** | secondary | 0 | – | 1 per 3 s | 1 (carry 2) | 10 | 5 | – | 0 | – | blocked | pickup, 1 per pickup |
| **Magnet Sneeze** | secondary | 0 | – | 1 per 1.5 s | 1 (carry 5) | 40 | 20 | – | 0 | – | blocked | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Polite Laser** | primary | 75 | 2 | 1 per 2 s | 25 energy | 40 | 120 | – | 5 | – | 50% passes through | pickup |
| **Seed Grenade** | secondary | 5 | 20 | 1/s | 1 (carry 3) | 25 | 100 | – | 1 | – | blocked | pickup, 2 per pickup |
| **Paperweight** | secondary | 0 | – | 1 per 2 s | 1 (carry 3) | 25 | 30 | – | 0 | – | blocked | banned |

- **Echo Cannon:** flies back along its path after 2 s.
- **Borrowed Time:** rewinds you 3 s; weapons offline 3 s.
- **Magnet Sneeze:** pulls things in a 60° cone within 20 u.
- **Polite Laser:** hold to charge, full at 1.5 s, no shot before 1.5 s, fires by itself.
- **Seed Grenade:** 2% chance of a giant rubber duck; gravity wells bend it.
- **Paperweight:** stops where it lands; a gravity well for 6 s pulls ships (yours too), debris and ordnance within 16 u at up to 30% of a Tinker's thrust, then fuses into a lump of weak rock; gravity wells bend it.
